lines.1: 「How about we make a substitution on this side too?」
lines.3: 「Yo. How does it feel to let the adrenaline carry you away?」
lines.4: 「Why does my body keep moving on its own...? This is the worst.」
lines.5: 「Thought so. You've got a pretty nasty look in your eyes.」
lines.6: 「Leave it to me. I'll handle the rest.」
lines.7: 「I was already pissed off today anyway. Bring on the fight.」
lines.8: Subaru charges into the men like a gale.
lines.10: 「Who is this guy? He's crazy strong, YO! Hey, somebody go get Hizaki, YO!」
lines.11: 「Wait, did we even do anything bad enough to get beaten up?」
lines.13: 「That's reason enough. Got a problem with it? Come at me.」
lines.14: 「Come on. Let's get out of here.」
